headline: Public docs teardown: highest-impact fixes and the automation layer to prioritize first

summary.executive_summary: Buildkite documentation audit covered 1,295 pages across a multi-project topology with 100% crawl coverage. Critical retrieval readiness scored 47.3/100 (weak band), driven by poor answerability (6.1%) and chunkability (37.61%), limiting AI-assisted support and search effectiveness. Despite detecting 1,293 API pages, 0% have usage documentation coverage, creating a significant onboarding and integration friction point. Evidence coverage is strong at 97.3%, and 8 confirmed broken internal links require immediate remediation. Link verification confidence is low (25%) due to 169 unverified URLs blocked by auth or rate limits.

key_findings.headline: Undocumented API operations
key_findings.business_consequence: Generate/update reference + how-to from OpenAPI and enforce drift checks.

key_findings.headline: Documentation freshness debt
key_findings.business_consequence: Prioritize stale pages via weekly SLA loop and lifecycle policies.

key_findings.headline: Code examples fail or are non-runnable
key_findings.business_consequence: Run smoke + expected-output checks and auto-fix broken snippets.

priority_actions.title: Restructure pages to improve answerability from 6.1% to >60% by adding FAQ sections, direct question-answer pairs, and conversational summaries
priority_actions.why_this_first: Unlocks AI-assisted support and chatbot effectiveness, reducing support ticket volume and improving self-service resolution rates within 30 days.

priority_actions.title: Add usage examples, code snippets, and integration guides to the 1,293 API pages currently at 0% usage-doc coverage
priority_actions.why_this_first: Directly unblocks developer onboarding and reduces time-to-first-integration, the highest-friction point in the sales-to-activation funnel.

priority_actions.title: Improve chunkability from 37.61% to >70% by adding semantic headings, breaking long sections, and inserting topic markers
priority_actions.why_this_first: Enhances semantic search and RAG retrieval quality, directly improving discoverability in AI-powered search tools used by prospects and customers.

strengths: Complete crawl coverage (100.08%) with 1,295 pages indexed, ensuring comprehensive audit scope
Strong evidence coverage at 97.3% (1,009 of 1,037 claims backed), supporting trust and credibility
High citationability at 99.92%, enabling effective source attribution in AI and search contexts
risks: Answerability at 6.1% means 94% of pages cannot effectively support conversational AI or chatbot retrieval, degrading self-service support quality
Chunkability at 37.61% limits semantic search and RAG pipeline performance, reducing discoverability in modern tooling
Zero API usage documentation coverage across 1,293 detected API pages creates steep learning curve and integration delays for developers
SEO/GEO issue rate of 16.51% (approximately 214 pages) risks reduced organic search visibility and regional discoverability
limitations: External audit cannot verify accuracy of technical claims, code correctness, or version-specific API behavior without runtime testing or subject-matter expert review.
169 unverified links (auth/rate-limit blocked) could not be validated; actual broken link count may be higher, and link confidence is only 25%.
Answerability and chunkability metrics reflect structural patterns but cannot guarantee semantic quality, tone appropriateness, or alignment with user mental models.
automation_first: Deploy automated API usage-doc coverage scanner to flag the 1,293 API pages missing usage examples, code snippets, or integration guides, with weekly reports to engineering and docs teams; expected payoff is continuous prevention of API documentation debt and 50% reduction in developer onboarding friction.

Implement answerability linter in CI/CD to block merges when new pages score below 40% answerability (current baseline 6.1%), enforcing FAQ sections and direct Q&A patterns; expected payoff is 10x improvement in chatbot and AI support accuracy within 90 days, reducing Tier-1 support load by 30%.

Add broken link checker running nightly on all 1,295 pages with authenticated crawling for the 169 currently unverified URLs, auto-filing GitHub issues for failures; expected payoff is zero user-facing broken links within 14 days and continuous link health monitoring with <24hr detection-to-fix cycle.
